title: Two Conversations She Chose
subtitle: 6–7 January 2026 · Rohit and Rinku
publicationNote: Author-requested draft for review. Rohit first kiss Wed 7 Jan about 17:22, Rinku first kiss about 21:27 are written as mutually chosen non-graphic scenes. Staff schedules, maintenance late shift and family whereabouts are NEW working-story choices, not retroactive canon. Existing EP04B–EP06 manuscripts untouched.

scenes.place: Malhotra home / Cyber City work communications
scenes.title: Tuesday: The Day Before
scenes.raw:
Tuesday subah Ankita ne apne laptop par Monday ke project notes reopen kiye. Wednesday evening ka Service Booking Portal demo ab actual calendar entry ban chuka tha, lekin ab tak koi formal tutoring session nahi hua tha. Aman ke saath Saturday ka Java question sirf ghar ka spontaneous doubt tha. Ayaan–Armaan ne CBT guidance maangi thi; time propose hua tha, lesson conduct nahi hua.

Aman table ke paas aaya. “Bhabhi, Tuesday mock-test ka kya hua?”

“Tumhara ya Ayaan–Armaan ka?”

“Unka. Tumne bola tha interface dikhaogi.”

“Propose kiya tha. Calendar mein confirm nahi kiya. Main Wednesday ke work-demo mein busy hoon. Pehli proper class uske baad plan karenge.”

“Noted,” Aman ne seedha kaha. “Mera Java doubt bhi abhi class nahi maana jayega?”

“Bilkul nahi,” Ankita hansi. “Uske liye bhi invoice bhej sakti hoon.”

Karan apna CV le aaya. “Aishwarya se Wednesday milna confirmed hai?”

“Introduction hoga. Interview tips milengi. Miracle nahi.”

Office ke din mein Rohit ko Wednesday ki AV test-cable requirement forward hui. Conversation purely project logistics ki thi: compatible adapter kaunsi output support karta hai, aur building ke monitor par same signal chalega ya nahi. Friday ka signed slip close hi raha.

Shaam ko society maintenance desk ka delayed callback aaya. Rinku ne short, formal tone mein kaha, “Madam, connector ka exact model aa gaya hai. Friday update nahi kar paaya, sorry. Kal evening ka last authorized maintenance slot mil sakta hai, service register mein entry rahegi.”

“Paanch din ka suspense finally khatam?” Ankita ne poocha.

Rinku ek second chup hua, phir hasa. “Connector wala, haan.”

Us jawab mein Friday ki awkwardness ka ek echo tha. Ankita ne calendar check kiya. “Office guests 8:15 tak rahenge. 8:55 ka slot confirm karo. Late service permitted ho tabhi.”

“Supervisor se confirm karke service message bhej dunga,” Rinku ne kaha.

Kabir ko Ankita ne sach-sach bataya ki overdue filter repair Wednesday late slot par ho sakta hai. “Main equipment ka check kar lungi,” usne kaha. “Tum production call par ho toh disturb nahi karungi.”

Kabir ne kaha, “Bas service log proper ho. Part mil gaya toh good.”

Ankita ne screen band ki. Rohit ek office context tha; Rinku ghar ki ongoing maintenance ka hissa. Dono ke saath Friday ki unsaid curiosity uske paas thi. Lekin Wednesday ko kya hoga, iska script abhi kisi ne nahi likha tha.

scenes.place: Malhotra home → Cyber City IT floor
scenes.title: Wednesday: Not Just Another Office Day
scenes.raw:
Wednesday ki subah Ankita ne wardrobe ke saamne khade hokar do minute extra liye. Dark tailored trousers, slate-blue sleeveless top aur loose ivory overshirt—sab professional the, lekin combination uske usual conservative work-layering se thoda zyada self-assured lag raha tha. Isme koi Friday-wali wet-clothing recreation nahi thi. Bas aaj woh apni appearance ko accidental decision nahi banana chahti thi.

Kabir ne bedroom doorway se kaha, “Presentation day?”

“Demo day. Aur guest day. Aur raat ko filter maintenance bhi.”

“Ek hi din mein sab?”

“Calendar software ka pura fayda utha rahi hoon.”

Kabir ne muskura kar coffee mug pass kiya. “Woh group saath aa raha hai na?”

“Reyansh drive karega. Aishwarya front seat, back mein Vivan, main aur Sana. Ghar pahunchkar Karan ko introduce karwaungi.”

“Perfect. Common table clear hai. Main evening mein on-call check kar sakta hoon. Emergency ho toh work nook mein rahunga.”

Karan ne corridor se awaaz lagayi, “Mera CV printed hai. Kisi ne file touch mat karna!”

Aman ne kaha, “Main sirf API docs laaya hoon, HR interview nahi dunga.”

Rajeev breakfast room mein newspaper ke pages fold kar rahe the. Ankita ne casually unse kaha ki shaam ko four office guests aayenge. Rajeev ne poocha, “Kitni der?”

“Around eight-fifteen wrap ho jayega.”

Daytime office kaam ordinary pace mein chala. Client updates, code review aur demo notes. Sana ne edge-case tests bheje, Vivan ne latest screens, Reyansh ne car group message. Ankita ne apni responsibility sabse pehle complete ki.

4:25 par ek support notification pop-up hua: requested display adapter tested and ready. Rohit ka naam tha.

Ankita ne screen dekhi aur kuch pal baad khud ko muskuraate hue paaya. Uska ek hissa chah raha tha ki Friday ki baat seedhi poochh le. Doosra jaanta tha ki office support counter ka apna professional boundary hota hai.

Usne laptop lock kiya, notes folder uthaya aur support bay ki taraf chal di.

scenes.place: Cyber City IT support bay → office-complex tea kiosk
scenes.title: Rohit: When the Checklist Ends
scenes.raw:
4:35 par support bay mein Rohit ek test monitor ke saamne khada tha. Ankita ki aahat par usne turn kiya. Friday ko jo ladka paperwork ke beech apna sentence kho deta tha, aaj usne pehle technical answer diya.

“HDMI conversion checked. Audio bhi pass. Aap home display par test kar lena, ye backup cable hai,” Rohit ne kaha.

“Impressive. Tumne sentence bhi complete kiya aur checklist bhi.”

Rohit hansa. “Friday ko aapne kaha tha naye problems milenge. Is baar problem aane se pehle cable ready hai.”

Ankita ne serial label dekha, phir uski taraf. “Friday tum itne serious nahi the.”

“Actually serious zyada tha. Bas bol nahi pa raha tha.”

“Main hi itni difficult thi?”

“Nahi.” Rohit ruka. “Unexpected thi.”

Woh seedha jawab tha. Ankita ke chehre par smile tik gayi. Friday ko pehle accidental moment ke baad usne jaanbujhkar uske reactions notice kiye the. Rohit ne kabhi us experience ko office gossip nahi banaya tha; na hi friendly access ka galat matlab nikala tha. Yeh restraint Ankita ko uske stammer se bhi zyada interesting laga.

“Tumne kisi ko bataya?” usne quietly poocha.

“Kya?” Rohit ne uski aankhon mein dekha. “Ki aap mujhse Friday ko mazaak kar rahi thi? Nahi. Woh aapka personal matter tha. Main apne kaam ka log banata hoon, logon ka nahi.”

Ankita ka expression thoda soften hua. “Good answer.”

5 baje tak practical work close ho gaya. Rohit ne shift desk ko handover diya. Ankita ne kaha, “Main team join karne se pehle chai lene ja rahi hoon. Tumhari break hai toh aa sakte ho. Work question nahi hai.”

Rohit ne clock dekhi. “Break hai. Aur agar personal question hai toh main pehle hi warn kar doon—ab main bilkul chup nahi rahunga.”

Office-complex kiosk ke paas log aa-ja rahe the. Ek covered seating corner tha jahan se main walkway dikhta tha, aur main walkway se woh dono. No magically camera-free hiding place. Ankita ne chai ka paper cup pakda; Rohit rail ke opposite side khada raha, until she casually moved to the bench.

“Yahan baith jao. Interview nahi le rahi.”

“Friday se meri interview practice chal rahi hai,” Rohit ne kaha.

“Achha. Toh tell me: us din actually awkward kyun hue the?”

Rohit ne bina dramatic confession ke kaha, “Maine notice kiya tha ki aap jaanbujhkar mujhe dekh rahi thi. Mujhe laga main galat samajh raha hoon. Aap meri colleague hain, senior bhi. Main assume nahi karna chahta tha.”

Ankita ne cup knee ke paas rakha. “Aur aaj?”

“Aaj aap mujhe work ke baad chai pe bula rahi hain. Main isko bhi assume nahi karunga. Bas poochhunga—kya hum thodi der personal baat kar sakte hain?”

“Hum already kar rahe hain.”

Dono hase. Silence awkward nahi raha. Rohit ne uski confidence ki tareef ki, bina uske kapdon par lecture diye. Ankita ne usse uski own work aspirations poochhi. Usne kaha ki woh technical support se cloud-operations taraf move karna chahta hai, lekin abhi basics aur ownership seekh raha hai. Ankita ko uski seriousness achhi lagi; usne koi promotion ya personal reward promise nahi kiya.

5:18 par passing crowd thoda kam hua. Conversation intimate hone ke liye empty room ki zarurat nahi thi. Rohit ne paper cup side table par rakha. Unki fingers tab briefly mili jab Ankita ne forgotten cable pouch uske haath se li, aur is baar dono ne khud apni hands withdraw karne mein ek extra heartbeat li.

Rohit ne seedha kaha, “Ankita, main tumse ek personal sawaal poochh sakta hoon? Agar uncomfortable ho toh yahin stop.”

Ankita ne notice kiya—usne pehli baar bina 'ma'am' ke naam liya, lekin poochhkar. “Poochho.”

“Tum... mere saath yahan sirf Friday ke joke ki wajah se ho?”

“Joke ne baat shuru ki thi,” Ankita ne dheere kaha. “Ab main tumhe sun rahi hoon.”

Woh kuch pal ek-doosre ko dekhte rahe. Rohit paas aaya, magar itna nahi ki usse choice ka waqt na mile. Ankita ne khud gap close kiya. “Rohit, main tumhe kiss karna chahti hoon. Tum?”

“Main bhi,” usne kaha.

5:22 ke aas-paas unka pehla kiss chhota tha—mutual, unexpected enough to leave a pause, lekin kisi surprise grab ka result nahi. Ankita ek step peeche hui. Rohit ki smile mein disbelief tha, phir warmth.

“Ab toh ek full sentence banta hai,” Ankita ne tease kiya.

Rohit ne halki hansi ke saath kaha, “Haan. Bas office mein isko announce nahi karna.”

“Of course not.” Uska smile ek second baad serious ho gaya. “Par hum dono ko sochna padega ki iske consequences hain.”

“Main samajhta hoon.”

5:30 tak Rohit normal break exit se wapas support block ki taraf gaya. Ankita apne project teammates ke paas lautne lagi. She had chosen a threshold, and unlike Friday's nervous curiosity, this one had a name. Office camera angles aur gossip ka risk real tha, par kiss ka koi witness ya recording is draft mein assert nahi hota.

scenes.place: Reyansh’s car → Malhotra home · work corner
scenes.title: Five Seats, Four Guests, One Very Ordinary Demo
scenes.raw:
6 baje ke aas-paas Reyansh ne office parking se group message bheja: “All set?” Aishwarya front passenger seat par baithi, Vivan aur Sana rear mein. Ankita bhi back seat par aayi. Total five seats; driver Reyansh. Rohit is car ya home visit ka member nahi tha.

“Project docs ready?” Sana ne poocha.

“Ready. Bas wifi ka password miss na ho,” Vivan ne kaha.

“Yeh technical architecture ka sabse difficult dependency hai,” Ankita ne joke kiya. Sab hans pade. Usne Rohit ke saath abhi jo hua, uska koi confession group mein nahi kiya. Kabhi-kabhi Ankita window ki taraf dekh rahi thi; aaj uski personal life aur project schedule ajeeb tarike se ek hi calendar mein aa gaye the.

Travel ke baad group 7:15 ke aas-paas Malhotra apartment pahuncha. Kabir ne living area mein projector table already clear kar diya tha. Rajeev reading corner mein the aur guests ko greeting karke apni magazine ki taraf laut gaye. Karan ne printed CV aur MBA presentation notes saamne rakhe. Aman ne code laptop side par rakha, bina pretend kiye ki yeh uski official class thi.

Aishwarya ne Karan ko greet kiya. “CV pehle dekhenge. MBA ke baad role selection clear karna hoga. Main honest feedback doongi.”

“That's what I need,” Karan ne kaha.

Dusri table par Ankita ne sample Service Booking Portal demo shuru kiya. Vivan screens navigate kar raha tha, Reyansh test workflow explain kar raha tha, Sana error cases note kar rahi thi. Ankita ne API service checks explain kiye. Yeh project practice tha, tuition nahi. Karan ko HR mentorship ka introduction mila; Aman ne ek short question poochha, phir apni laptop window mein laut gaya.

Monitor cable connect karne ke waqt Ankita ka loose ivory overshirt chair arm se momentarily catch hua aur ek shoulder se slip hua. Slate-blue inner top wahi raha. Vivan ne ek second dekha, phir screen par nazar wapas kar li. Sana ne discreetly overshirt edge point kiya. Ankita ne khud layer correct ki; Reyansh ne cable plug check kiya. Kisi ne photo nahi li, aur isko dramatic new reveal nahi banaya gaya.

“Connection stable,” Reyansh ne kaha.

Ankita ne half-smile ke saath jawab diya, “Finally. Ab data bhi stable rakho.”

8:10 tak demo aur CV feedback ke main points cover ho gaye. Kabir family side ke paas tha, par ek incoming IT on-call alert dekhkar adjacent work nook mein chala gaya; woh ghar se gayab nahi hua. Karan ne Aishwarya ko thank you kaha. Aman ne apne Java notes close kiye.

8:15 ke baad guests normal goodbyes ke saath nikalne lage. Reyansh ne sabko car mein bithana tha; by 8:35 last hallway goodbyes complete hue. Rajeev ab bhi apne room side mein the. Kabir work nook par check-in call handle kar raha tha. Karan apne CV notes revise kar raha tha; Aman coding question ke saath living table par tha.

Ankita ne cups rinse kiye aur bag se apna phone nikala. Maintenance desk ka 8:45 confirmation tha: Rinku ka authorized last service ticket active, replacement connector on hand, 8:55 arrival. Ghar mein sabko general repair ka pata tha.

Usne kaam ke outfit ko replace karke deep-teal wrap kurta aur comfortable trousers pehne—regular home wear se zara dressier, apni marzi ka decision. Mirror ke saamne usne ek pal khud ko dekha. Rohit ke saath wala kiss abhi yaad tha. Rinku ke saath kya ho sakta hai, yeh sochkar usne ek gehri saans li.

Aaj repair ka reason real tha. Lekin apne mann mein yeh maan lena ki woh sirf filter ke liye excited hai, ab khud se jhooth hota.

scenes.place: Malhotra kitchen → Gulmohar Heights covered walkway
scenes.title: Rinku: The Repair Was Finished; the Question Wasn’t
scenes.raw:
8:55 par doorbell baji. Rinku maintenance pouch aur sealed connector ke saath khada tha. Usne service log phone par dikhaya. Ankita ne door khola toh uske pehle words strictly practical the.

“Madam, model number match kar diya. Pressure check bhi karna hoga.”

Ankita ne eyebrow uthaya. “Paanch din ke baad tumhare paas poori script ready hai?”

Rinku hasa. “Is baar ready rehna tha.”

Ankita deep-teal kurta mein thi. Usne koi artificial water splash ya wardrobe mishap plan nahi kiya tha. Friday ko uske appearances ke baare mein Rinku ki awkward reaction ab unke beech ek unsaid memory thi. Is baar Rinku ne outfit notice kiya, lekin uske chehre par woh startled silence nahi tha. Woh door ke paas ek pal ruka aur kaha, “Aaj aap alag lag rahi hain.”

“Alag achhi ya alag difficult?”

“Achhi,” Rinku ne bina bahana banaye kaha. “Par pehle filter theek kar doon?”

“Excellent priority,” Ankita hansi. Woh usse kitchen tak le gayi.

Kitchen doorway ke us paar household ke normal sounds aa rahe the. Kabir adjacent work nook mein production-call status dekh raha tha. Karan CV notes revise kar raha tha. Aman coding screen ke saath common table par tha. Rajeev apne room ke paas reading corner mein the. Rinku ka visit secret tunnel se nahi aaya tha; registered service call tha.

9:06 ke aas-paas Rinku ne connector fit kiya aur valve pressure test ki. Ankita ne phone flashlight available rakhi, lekin tool par bina zarurat haath nahi dala. Repair complete hua, receipt sign hui. Rinku ne valve ko ek baar phir observe kiya.

“Ab leakage nahi hona chahiye,” usne kaha.

“'Nahi hona chahiye' aur 'nahi hoga' mein difference hai, Rinku babu.”

“Engineer wali questioning?”

“Tech lead wali.”

Rinku hansa. “Kal ek baar confirm kar lena. Agar issue hua toh main ticket reopen karunga.”

Ankita ne service completion message approve kiya. Duty khatam ho chuki thi. Rinku exit ki taraf mud gaya. Ankita ne uska naam liya, is baar bina repair ka excuse banaye.

“Rinku, do minute. Main bhi neeche tak chalti hoon. Din bhar office aur visitors ke baad fresh air chahiye.”

Woh uski taraf dekhta raha. “Sure? Late ho gaya hai.”

“Ghar mein sabko pata hai service hui hai. Walk meri marzi hai.”

9:12 ke aas-paas dono lift se main lobby mein aaye. Covered walkway mein soft white lamps the; door ke beyond garden path visible tha. Guard station door se doori thi, lekin poori jagah permanently private nahi thi. Rinku service gate ki taraf jaana chahta tha; Ankita uske saath chalte-chalte ruk gayi.

“Friday tum aise kyun nikle the?” usne poocha.

Rinku ne pehle typical polite jawab dene ki koshish ki. “Kaam tha, madam.”

“Rinku. Kaam toh tumhe 1 January ko bhi tha. Main us baat ke baare mein poochh rahi hoon jo hum dono avoid kar rahe hain.”

Rinku ne apna tool pouch shoulder se shift kiya. “Aap meri taraf dekh kar jaanbujhkar smile kar rahi thi. Mujhe samajh nahi aa raha tha ki main galat soch raha hoon ya aap...”

“Ya main tumhari reaction dekhna chahti thi?” Ankita ne sentence complete kiya.

“Haan.”

“Main dekhna chahti thi,” usne honestly kaha. “Aur jab tum bina kuch bole chale gaye toh mujhe laga shayad main tumhe uncomfortable kar gayi.”

Rinku ne aankhein uthayi. “Uncomfortable nahi. Surprised. Aap mere saath usually itni normal rehti hain. Main aapko respect karta hoon. Mujhe darr laga ki agar main kuch personal bol dunga toh aap sochengi main apna kaam bhool gaya.”

Ankita ki teasing halka sa soften hui. “Kaam tumne aaj finish kar diya. Ab tum apni baat keh sakte ho.”

Rinku ne ek saans li. “Aap achhi lagti hain. Pehle bhi. Bas aaj bol diya.”

“Pehle kyun nahi?”

“Pehle aapke ghar repair karne aata tha. Aur aaj bhi wahi karta hoon. Lekin main aapko sirf customer samajhkar baat nahi kar pa raha.”

Uski honesty mein awkwardness thi, lekin koi rehearsed speech nahi. Ankita ko woh baat touch kar gayi. She knew he was not a copy of Rohit: Rohit ne office mein apni boundaries aur ambition dikhayi thi; Rinku ne weeks of ordinary service familiarity aur direct sincerity.

“Tumhe meri Friday ki teasing yaad rahi?” Ankita ne poocha.

“Har line nahi. Bas aapka mujhe dekhna.”

Ankita hansi, phir chup hui. “Mujhe bhi.”

9:25 ke aas-paas walkway ke corner par dono ruk gaye. Public path unke peeche tha, aur building entrance kuch steps door. Ankita ne Rinku ka haath gently pakda, phir uski taraf dekha. Rinku ne apni hand relaxed rakhi; dono ne eye contact nahi toda.

“Ankita... main kuch assume nahi karna chahta,” Rinku ne dheere kaha. Pehli baar usne 'madam' chhoda.

“Toh mat karo,” Ankita ne kaha. “Poochho.”

“Main tumhe kiss kar sakta hoon?”

Ankita ne ek beat li. Woh Kabir ki wife thi. Is choice ka weight use samajh aa raha tha. Saath hi, woh Rinku ko apne response se confuse nahi karna chahti thi. “Haan. Main bhi chahti hoon.”

9:27 ke aas-paas dono thoda paas aaye. First kiss brief aur mutual tha. Rinku ne pehle hi saans mein thoda distance banaya; Ankita uski face par surprise dekhkar hansi, par hansna uski nervousness ko dismiss karna nahi tha.

“Ab bhi itni khamoshi?” usne tease kiya.

Rinku ne sharmili smile ke saath kaha, “Ab toh bolne ke liye kuch mil hi nahi raha.”

“Achha, phir pehle se better hai. Tum smile toh kar rahe ho.”

Dono ne ek second aur saath khade rehkar apni choice ka reality feel kiya. Phir Rinku serious hua. “Aap okay ho na?”

“Main okay hoon,” Ankita ne kaha. “Lekin situation simple nahi hai.”

“Main jaanta hoon.”

Koi dramatic promise nahi hua. Koi second accidental touch engineer nahi kiya gaya. Walkway par kisi specific neighbour ko witness nahi banaya gaya, lekin society cameras ya night staff ka possible observation risk real raha.

9:40 tak Rinku normal service exit se chala gaya. Ankita lift ki taraf mudhi. Uske lips par muskurahat ab bhi thi, lekin saath mein ek naya, heavier thought bhi: Aaj usne do alag men ke saath two different decisions liye the. Upar Kabir, Karan, Aman aur Rajeev ka ordinary ghar abhi bhi waisa hi tha.

scenes.place: Malhotra apartment · hall / Kabir’s work nook
scenes.title: The House Hasn't Changed
scenes.raw:
Lift se nikalte hue Ankita ne deep-teal kurta ke sleeve ko seedha kiya. Koi visible evidence chhupane ke liye nahi—ek habitual gesture, jis par aaj use khud hansi aa gayi. Ghar ka darwaza khola toh living area mein Aman apne headphones ke saath laptop par tha. Karan CV ke last paragraph ko revise kar raha tha.

“Filter done?” Aman ne bina screen se nazar hataye poocha.

“Done,” Ankita ne jawab diya. “Tomorrow ek baar test kar lenge.”

Karan ne kaha, “Aishwarya ne kaafi direct feedback diya hai. Thanks, bhabhi.”

“Uspe kaam karna. Introduction enough nahi hota,” Ankita ne normal tone mein kaha.

Rajeev ne reading corner se poocha, “Koi problem toh nahi thi?”

“Part fit ho gaya,” Ankita ne seedha kaha. Rinku ka service ticket sach mein complete hua tha. Woh poora jhooth nahi bol rahi thi—lekin apne evening ka sabse significant hissa bhi nahi bata rahi thi.

Kabir work nook se aaya. “Finally no leaking filter?”

“Finally.”

Usne Ankita ki taraf dekha. “You look tired. Two demos ek din mein?”

Ankita ne ek chhoti si laugh nikali. “One demo, one repair. Aur ek bahut lamba din.”

Kabir ne uske kandhe par warm, ordinary hand rakha. “Water, then sleep. Kal se routine.”

Routine. Word sunte hi Ankita ke dimaag mein Rohit ka campus kiosk aur Rinku ka walkway ek saath aa gaye. Dono kisses alag the; dono deliberate the. Uska marriage bhi deliberate, living commitment tha. Ye contradiction usse kisi narrator ki punishment ki tarah nahi, apne liye ek serious personal question ki tarah mehsoos hua.

Kabir ne poocha, “Sab okay?”

Ankita ne uski taraf dekha. “Haan. Bas... mujhe kuch cheezein sort karni hain.”

“Work?”

“Sab kuch thoda.”

Kabir ne aur press nahi kiya. Woh paani lene kitchen gaya. Ankita kuch pal living room mein ruki. Aman ki code compile sound, Karan ka CV print, Rajeev ki magazine pages aur Kabir ki footsteps—sab ordinary tha. Kisi ko unexplained intuition se aaj ki private kiss ka full knowledge nahi mila.

Us raat Ankita ne koi dramatic confession nahi kiya. Na Rohit ko late-night message, na Rinku ko ek aur teasing call. Wednesday ka endpoint wahi tha: do first kisses, ek active marriage, aur kuch difficult choices jo ab postpone nahi ki ja sakti thi.

Episode 07 · Ankita · End of working manuscript.
